original.target_description: Basic interchangeable-dyad Actor–Partner Interdependence Model: actor effect of baseline dispositional optimism on own perceived stress at three-month follow-up, heterosexual romantic couples; Figure 1 paths a. The replication report explicitly identifies this focal claim despite empty input locators.

n.sample_role: couple dyads in final longitudinal sample (Table 1 separately prints N = 170 participants)
n.exclusions: 111 couples completed baseline; 85 also completed follow-up. No further target-test exclusions reported.
n.location: p. 147, Procedure and participants; p. 149, basic APIM omnibus test (N = 85)
n.quote: A total of 111 couples completed the questionnaires at baseline. Of these, 85 couples completed the questionnaires also at follow-up.

es.location: p. 149, Results, Optimism and perceived stress, Figure 1 paths a
es.quote: The analysis revealed a significant actor effect, ß = -0.25, P < .001 (paths a)

p.location: p. 149, Results, Optimism and perceived stress, Figure 1 paths a
p.quote: The analysis revealed a significant actor effect, ß = -0.25, P < .001 (paths a)

replication.target_description: Hostler and Persson SCORE direct replication k5z: interchangeable-dyad APIM actor effect of optimism on own perceived stress, with actor and partner effects constrained across gender; report at supplied OSF file c2hry.

n.sample_role: couple dyads included in replication APIM analysis
n.exclusions: Report states incomplete and irrelevant data removed before analysis. Five couples with inconsistent cohabitation responses were retained; two also had minor relationship-length discrepancies (<1 year). Initial recruited total not reported in this report.
n.location: PDF p. 2, Replication result and omnibus test; pp. 2–3, Deviations from preregistration
n.quote: The replication included 101 couple dyads in the sample.

es.location: PDF p. 2, Replication result, focal actor effect
es.quote: The actor effect of optimism on perceived stress was b = -0.298, z= -9.529, p<.001 (p = .000 as reported by MPlus)

p.location: PDF p. 2, Replication result, focal actor effect
p.quote: The actor effect of optimism on perceived stress was b = -0.298, z= -9.529, p<.001 (p = .000 as reported by MPlus)

reported_success.quote: Thus, the replication of the claim was successful according to the SCORE criteria.

notes: Input contains no study identifier, neutral description, or test locators. Focal test established independently from supplied replication report claim summary, then matched to original basic APIM. Original β and replication unstandardized b retained as printed without conversion; requested replication es_type ser_method is not a printed effect-size metric. Replication reports p < .001 and parenthetically MPlus p = .000; retained narrative bound rather than treating rounded software zero as exact probability. Both full-text titles verified against supplied references. Original obtained from University of Konstanz repository after DOI landing page challenge; replication obtained from OSF author report. No author project table or FORRT source used.
